en: I don't know much about magic, but there's a mage named Zaldimar who is staying at the Lion's Pride Inn that could probably assist you.
Protect me from this $n! I must return to my brood.
I missed you too, honey.  And I'm finally home...
Cover me, soldier! I have to make it back to our base and get the fleet prepped for an aerial assault!
Cover me, I'm making a break for it!
So long as you stay here with us, you da king.  You take off, and some other ogre will take your place.  That's da way of da Gordok!
There we go. All done!
I have lost my Shroud of Unspoken Names. Are you able to replace it for me?
Question 1, Chain 1?
Sweet, sweet embrace... take me...
Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

Thank you for saving me!$B$BI'm a cook and an alchemist from Stormwind.  I was here looking for local herbs and recipes for my uncle Angus when these quilboar captured me.  If you hadn't come around, I'm sure I'd have ended up in their stew pot!
The Dun Baldar North Bunker protects the eastern entrance to Dun Baldar.$B$BIt is controlled by the Alliance.
%s is reduced to rubble, but still continues to fight
Would a fly without wings be called a walk?
sneezes voilently!
Sending ground assaults takes huge amounts of supplies!
Kill the guards, take the Warden alive!
Thank you, $G lad:lass;. Thank you, greatly.
Larion, I want to help you fight these pests!
You did it... you've slain Baron Rivendare!  The Argent Dawn shall hear of your valiant deeds!
Prepare yourselves for an eternity of anguish and torture - vengeance shall be mine...
Such sssorrow... The passst cannot be undone...
You mess with Silas, you mess with me.  Have a nice day.
I'm all ears.
Where is Elder Bladeswift?
I am free! Let's work together now to save my sister, Jarien!
Thank you, $n! I'm free!!!
It's good to see you again, Erland.  What is your report?
Good luck with Arugal. I must hurry back to Hadrec now.
Ah yes, it is Seikwa that you must find.  I believe I saw her last standing out in front of the inn.
I can not train you.

When the work of a blacksmith reaches your level of expert craftsmanship, I present them with a choice.$B$BWhile you are not required to make a choice, it is recommended that you do - after all, do you want to be a neophyte forever? It is the artisan armorsmiths and weaponsmiths that supply our armies, win our wars and garner acclaim!$B$BBe warned, $n. Once a choice is made and the tasks required completed - there is no going back. One can only walk down one path.
The time has come, Guse. You fly again!
My apologies, Lady Prestor.
Hmm? Oh yes, I can teach you something if you desire. But stay away from Sumi and Tumi, they are not for the likes of you. Saru only let's those of great skill approach his daughters.

To summon a Dreadsteed, you must first create a Circle of Greater Summoning.  A portal to Xoroth may only be created from within such a circle.$B$BThe Circle of Greater Summoning requires three powerful implements: a Bell of Dethmoora, a Wheel of the Black March and a Doomsday Candle.
Take that! Oh... I must have hit the wrong button... Wait, try this one!
I require aid.

I, like many others, came to aid my fellow druids when the war started.$B$BNow that the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj are open, I've realized that much work still remains to be done.  I've decided to stay in Silithus and do my best to help the cause, $n.

The Warchief has instructed me to study all kinds of weapons and armor. He has sent me here to the hub of both the tauren and orc cultures in the Barrens to meet as many travelers as possible, and to learn about the cultures of the Barrens.$B$BHe feels there's something to be learned from even the most pathetic of cultures... like the quilboar or centaur.
The door is open, Kharan. You are a free man.
Ahhh, Stormwind Visitor's Center is what you are looking for then. It's the first building on the left as you walk through the front gates from the Valley of Heroes.
Continue...
You might be able to take me, but the Defias WILL take back Stormwind!
Adventurers from all over sell things to Antonio-- come look for yourselves what little treasures he has for you this week.
%s is not impressed.
%s fully engulfs in flame and a maddened look appears in his eyes!
Death to the Warden!
